scope_note: Payment institution authorised by the ACPR, 50 employees, operating in France, Belgium and Spain. Provides a cloud payment platform to merchants and publishes a payment SDK embedded in their applications.

profile.objective: Establish which texts apply ahead of the 2027 ACPR audit and decide on this year's compliance budget.

n1: Confirm that the ACPR authorisation does not also cover issuing electronic money: that would change the type of financial entity.
n2: The payment SDK is distributed free of charge but bundled into a paid offer: treated as placed on the market under the CRA.
n3: Obtain the register of ICT providers kept by Procurement (format and date of last update).
n4: The DPO and the CISO remain two separate functions; the CISO becomes the DORA point of contact.
Dedicated function and point of contact

iso.8.16: Monitoring entrusted to the hosting provider, outside the management system.
